art_direction: 透明与乳白吹制玻璃形成三枝抽象珊瑚，细气泡与边缘折射清晰。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Render a small hand-blown glass sculpture with three branching coral-like arms rising from one rounded base. Combine clear glass with milky white inclusions and a faint sea-green core. The branches should be thick enough to read as a unified silhouette, with subtle asymmetry and softly pinched tips. Include a few tiny trapped air bubbles and restrained edge refraction. Light it on a pale stone surface against a desaturated blue background. Avoid excessive sparkle, rainbow dispersion, underwater scenery, or a dense forest of branches. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
